const fs = require\(''fs''\);
const content = \\`# Adding a New Box Design Variant

## Product
Monoatom Labs — CERAPHENE Graphene Ceramic Coating box packaging.

---

## Folder structure
designs/
  registry.js               <- register every new variant here
  wrap/<Name>/index.jsx
  back/<Name>/index.jsx
  flaps/<Name>/index.jsx
  qr/<Name>/index.jsx

Read the existing GrapheneV1 for the panel you are working on before writing anything.
Imports inside design files go up 3 levels: ../../../

---

## Panel sizes & props

### wrap
Props: { scale=1, surfBack, surfLeft, surfFront, surfRight }
Flat lay: back-face | left-spine | front-face | right-spine | glue-tab

  const BOX = { face: 5.2, side: 2.13, total: 15.567, height: 6.65 }
  const TAB_W = BOX.total - 2*BOX.face - 2*BOX.side   // 0.907""
  const px = i => Math.round\(i * 96 * scale\)

  backW  = px\(BOX.face\)    frontW = px\(BOX.face\)
  side1W = px\(BOX.side\)    side2W = px\(BOX.side\)    tabW = px\(TAB_W\)
  H      = px\(BOX.height\)

### back
Props: { scale=1, surf }
  W = Math.round\(1494 * scale\)    H = Math.round\(638 * scale\)

### flaps
Props: { scale=1, hideLabels=false, contentsFlapId, logoFlapId, surfContents, surfLogo }
  W = Math.round\(499 * scale\)     H = Math.round\(204 * scale\)   \(per flap\)
  Contents flap root div must have  id={contentsFlapId}
  Logo flap root div must have      id={logoFlapId}

### qr
Props: { scale=1, surf }
  W = Math.round\(605 * scale\)     H = Math.round\(492 * scale\)

Scale every pixel value by scale \(alias: const fs = scale\).

---

## Studio components — import, never reimplement

### SurfaceBg  \(studio/SurfaceBg\)
Animated hex / lattice background. Use in every panel section that has a background.

  import SurfaceBg from ''../../../studio/SurfaceBg''

  // Container must be: position relative, overflow hidden
  // SurfaceBg sits at zIndex 0 \(absolute inset 0\)
  // Your content goes at zIndex 3+
  <SurfaceBg surf={surf} />

  surf shape: { time, bg: ''wave''|''dark''|''lattice'', latticeSize, latticeBright, latticeDepth }
  Fallback:   const DEFAULT_SURF = { time: 3200, bg: ''wave'' }

### QRCodeImage  \(studio/QRCodeImage\)
QR code renderer — use in any qr panel design.

  import QRCodeImage from ''../../../studio/QRCodeImage''
  <QRCodeImage url={WEBSITE_URL} size={qrSize} fgColor=""#ffffff"" bgColor=""#000000"" />

### Logo  \(brand/Logo\)
  import Logo from ''../../../brand/Logo''
  <Logo size={42 * fs} theme=""dark"" />   // theme=""dark"" = white logo

---

## Registry
After writing the component, open registry.js and add:
  import YourComponent from ''./<panel>/<Name>''
  { id: ''<Name>'', label: ''<Label>'', Component: YourComponent }

---

## Everything else — make it your own.

## Product
Monoatom Labs — CERAPHENE Graphene Ceramic Coating
Box style: Rigid sleeve / wrap-around carton

## Physical Print Specifications

### 1. Wrap Panel  \(flat-lay artwork — wraps around the box\)
Total size:  15.567"" × 6.65""
Pixel size:  1494 × 638 px  \(at scale=1, 96 dpi\)

Sections left → right when laid flat:

  ┌──────────┬────────┬──────────┬────────┬────────┐
  │ Back     │ Left   │ Front    │ Right  │  Glue  │
  │ Face     │ Spine  │ Face     │ Spine  │  Tab   │
  │ 5.2""     │ 2.13""  │ 5.2""     │ 2.13""  │ 0.907"" │
  └──────────┴────────┴──────────┴────────┴────────┘
  All sections share height: 6.65""

  Pixel widths \(scale=1\):
    Back face  : 499 px    Left spine : 204 px
    Front face : 499 px    Right spine: 204 px
    Glue tab   : 87 px

  Each section receives its own SurfaceBg:
    surfBack, surfLeft, surfFront, surfRight

### 2. Back Panel  \(separate flat artwork\)
Size:  15.567"" × 6.65""
Pixel: 1494 × 638 px  \(at scale=1\)
Single surface: surf

### 3. Flap Panels  \(two separate top/bottom closure flaps\)
Each flap size:  5.2"" × 2.13""
Each flap pixel: 499 × 204 px  \(at scale=1\)

Two flaps rendered side by side in the component:
  Contents Flap  — lists box contents, id={contentsFlapId}
  Logo Flap      — logo + tagline,    id={logoFlapId}

Each flap has its own surface: surfContents, surfLogo

### 4. QR Panel  \(inside-lid or insert card\)
Size:  6.303"" × 5.123""
Pixel: 605 × 492 px  \(at scale=1\)
Single surface: surf

---

## Resolution & Scale

Base resolution: 96 dpi \(scale=1\)
Export resolution: 3× or 4× via html2canvas \(288–384 dpi, suitable for print\)

All pixel values in code must multiply by scale:
  const fs = scale
  const px = i => Math.round\(i * 96 * scale\)

## Product
Monoatom Labs — CERAPHENE Graphene Ceramic Coating
Box style: Rigid sleeve / wrap-around carton

---

## Physical Print Specifications

### 1. Wrap Panel  \(flat-lay — wraps around the full box\)
Total size:  15.567"" × 6.65""
Pixel size:  1494 × 638 px  \(at scale=1, 96 dpi\)

Sections left → right when laid flat:

  ┌──────────┬────────┬──────────┬────────┬────────┐
  │ Back     │ Left   │ Front    │ Right  │  Glue  │
  │ Face     │ Spine  │ Face     │ Spine  │  Tab   │
  │  5.2""    │ 2.13""  │  5.2""    │ 2.13""  │ 0.907"" │
  └──────────┴────────┴──────────┴────────┴────────┘
  All sections share height: 6.65""

  Pixel widths at scale=1:
    Back face  : 499 px    Left spine : 204 px
    Front face : 499 px    Right spine: 204 px
    Glue tab   : 87 px

  Geometry constants — copy exactly:
    const BOX = { face: 5.2, side: 2.13, total: 15.567, height: 6.65 }
    const TAB_W = BOX.total - 2 * BOX.face - 2 * BOX.side  // 0.907""
    const px = i => Math.round\(i * 96 * scale\)

    const W = px\(BOX.total\)      const H = px\(BOX.height\)
    backW  = px\(BOX.face\)        side1W = px\(BOX.side\)
    frontW = px\(BOX.face\)        side2W = px\(BOX.side\)
    tabW   = px\(TAB_W\)

### 2. Back Panel  \(separate flat artwork, same sheet size as wrap\)
Size:  15.567"" × 6.65""
Pixel: 1494 × 638 px  \(scale=1\)

  const W = Math.round\(1494 * scale\)
  const H = Math.round\(638 * scale\)

### 3. Flap Panels  \(two top/bottom closure flaps, printed separately\)
Each flap:  5.2"" × 2.13""
Each pixel: 499 × 204 px  \(scale=1\)

  const W = Math.round\(499 * scale\)
  const H = Math.round\(204 * scale\)

Two flaps rendered side by side in one component:
  Contents Flap — lists what is in the box
  Logo Flap     — brand logo + tagline

Export IDs \(hardcoded by ExportAllView — your root divs must accept these\):
  Contents flap root:  id={contentsFlapId}   export value: ""export-flap-contents""
  Logo flap root:      id={logoFlapId}        export value: ""export-flap-logo""

hideLabels prop: when true, suppress any dev-only label text above flaps.

### 4. QR Panel  \(inside-lid insert or authentication card\)
Size:  6.303"" × 5.123""
Pixel: 605 × 492 px  \(scale=1\)

  const W = Math.round\(605 * scale\)
  const H = Math.round\(492 * scale\)

Product URL to encode in QR:
  https://www.monoatomlabs.com/products/ceraphene

---

## Resolution & Scale

Base: 96 dpi at scale=1
Preview scales passed by BoxPreview:
  wrap: 0.72    back: 0.72    flaps: 1.4    qr: 1.1
Export scale passed by ExportAllView: 1.0 \(all panels\)
html2canvas captures at 3–4× → 288–384 dpi, print-ready

All pixel values must multiply by scale. Alias: const fs = scale

---

## Root container rules \(every panel''s outermost div\)

  position: ''relative''
  overflow:  ''hidden''
  flexShrink: 0          // prevents squishing in flex layouts
  userSelect: ''none''     // no text selection on artwork
  backgroundColor: ''#050505''

Wrap root also needs: display: ''flex''
Each wrap section also needs: flexShrink: 0

---

## Surf keys passed by App \(what each surf prop is named in state\)

  wrap  → surfBack=surfs.wrapBack, surfLeft=surfs.wrapLeft,
           surfFront=surfs.wrapFront, surfRight=surfs.wrapRight
  back  → surf=surfs.back
  flaps → surfContents=surfs.flapsContents, surfLogo=surfs.flapsLogo
  qr    → surf=surfs.qr

Surf object shape:
  { time: number, bg: ''wave''|''dark''|''lattice'',
    latticeSize: number, latticeBright: number, latticeDepth: number }

Default: const DEFAULT_SURF = { time: 3200, bg: ''wave'' }

---

## Panel props \(full signatures\)

  wrap  : { scale=1, surfBack=DEFAULT_SURF, surfLeft=DEFAULT_SURF,
             surfFront=DEFAULT_SURF, surfRight=DEFAULT_SURF }

  back  : { scale=1, surf=DEFAULT_SURF }

  flaps : { scale=1, hideLabels=false, contentsFlapId, logoFlapId,
             surfContents=DEFAULT_SURF, surfLogo=DEFAULT_SURF }

  qr    : { scale=1, surf=DEFAULT_SURF }

---

## Folder structure & imports

designs/
  registry.js               <- register every new variant here
  wrap/<Name>/index.jsx
  back/<Name>/index.jsx
  flaps/<Name>/index.jsx
  qr/<Name>/index.jsx

Imports from a design file go up 3 levels \(../../../\):
  import SurfaceBg   from ''../../../studio/SurfaceBg''
  import QRCodeImage from ''../../../studio/QRCodeImage''
  import Logo        from ''../../../brand/Logo''

---

## Studio components — import, never reimplement

### SurfaceBg  →  ../../../studio/SurfaceBg
Renders hex wave / dark / lattice background.
Must be the first child of any section container.
Container: position relative, overflow hidden.
SurfaceBg is absolute inset 0, zIndex 0.
Your content: position relative, zIndex 3 or higher.

  <SurfaceBg surf={surf} />

### QRCodeImage  →  ../../../studio/QRCodeImage
All QR generation lives here. Never generate QR inline in a design.

  <QRCodeImage url={WEBSITE_URL} size={qrSize} fgColor=""#ffffff"" bgColor=""#000000"" />

### Logo  →  ../../../brand/Logo
  <Logo size={42 * fs} theme=""dark"" />
  theme=""dark"" = white logo on dark background

---

## zIndex layers

  0  SurfaceBg canvas \(internal\)
  1  Decorative SVG / pattern overlays on background
  2  Subtle grid lines, vignette gradients
  3  Main content — text, icons, logo
  4  Top-layer overlays — badges, floating spec panels

---

Open registry.js, add import and push entry:
  import YourComponent from ''./<panel>/<Name>''
  { id: ''<Name>'', label: ''<Label>'', Component: YourComponent }
